concepts.name: 느긋한 장부 가게
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE finished high-fidelity desktop web app screen concept, straight-on, landscape 16:10 around 1920x1200, crisp readable Korean typography.
Product: 시간 암시장 / TIME BLACK MARKET. A friendly underground corner shop run by a sly mole named 몰래 사장, keeping a ledger of postponed tasks as "time debt". This is a personal task/time dashboard, NOT real financial lending.
Input image 1 is the EXACT chosen mascot identity reference. Preserve this character's head/body proportions, fedora with red ribbon, glasses, pink nose, one gold tooth, green apron and red ledger; faithfully integrate it prominently into the UI and do not redesign its identity.
Input image 2 is the current app screenshot, supplied for information architecture and brand context ONLY. Design a convincing new visual direction around the selected character. Keep the functional task screen recognizable and useful.
Compose a complete well-aligned desktop viewport with intentional grid, generous whitespace, left/right page margins and readable controls. Render the actual app screen edge-to-edge, no laptop/device mockup, no browser chrome, no outer presentation frame, no collage, no split-screen, no multiple alternative screens.
Same content for both comparison concepts: top header with small mole mark, title "시간 암시장", small subtitle "TIME BLACK MARKET", status "영업 중" and a day/night toggle. Five navigation items "오늘 할 일", "캘린더", "사장님 상담", "외상 장부", "장부 분석"; 오늘 할 일 is active. A compact welcoming top section with the mascot and heading "미룬 일도, 하나씩 갚아가요." and short supporting line "오늘 못 한 일, 몰래 사장에게 맡겨요." Do not let marketing content push the actual tasks below the screen.
Main utility content in a clear useful hierarchy: a dark-green primary time-debt card labelled "지금 장부에 달린 외상" with large "2시간 30분" and smaller "남은 일 3개"; a recommendation card labelled "갚기 좋은 날" with "11월 11일 (수)" and a small red approval stamp. The task work area labelled "오늘은 뭘 달아둘까요?" includes a real-looking horizontal input reading "오늘 미룬 일을 적어주세요" plus a brick-red CTA "사장님, 감정해줘요". Below it a neatly aligned checklist of three tasks: "주간 보고서 마무리" with "45분", "기획안 피드백" with "1시간", "영수증 정리" with "45분". Checkbox controls on the left, time chips on the right, subtle row separators. A small side receipt panel labelled "오늘 달아둔 외상" showing "2시간 30분", and a small friendly quote from the proprietor. Keep all visible task and calendar numbers consistent. Footer "시간은 외상으로, 갚을 땐 기분 좋게."
Palette shared with the brand: warm cream #F4EDDD / #FFFAF0, forest green #46715A / #354C3D, brick red #AD382B, chocolate ink #302B24, subtle mustard #E5B853. Strong readable text contrast. Main text and controls are readable Korean, short and correctly spelled, set in clean Korean sans with bold characterful display headings. Time numerals with clear tabular typography.
Avoid: generic banking fintech branding, sterile corporate SaaS, excessive decorative props, repeated hero mascots, illegible microtext, arbitrary charts or invented features, purple or neon, cluttered overlapping panels, giant empty dashboard areas, concept labels such as "candidate 4" inside the UI, camera perspective that makes the UI difficult to read.
Visual direction for CANDIDATE 04: a refined, gently kitschy old neighborhood ledger shop. The exact TALL, SLENDER, LONG-SNOUTED illustrated mole from image 1 belongs here, with his long green apron and relaxed hand on hip, carrying the ledger. Keep his illustrated 2D style and grown-up quietly confident personality. Make him about one quarter of the viewport width, placed naturally beside a welcoming message and integrated with a small walnut counter edge; preserve his feet/body proportions rather than making a floating head.
Translate his personality throughout the UI: warm lightly textured paper, precise fine chocolate linework, slim brass hardware, a narrow walnut-wood shelf or counter trim, paper ledger panels with faint ruled lines, one small brass binder clip, perforated paper receipt, modest red stamped recommendation, deep moss-green book-cover summary panel. Restrained rectangular cards with 6-10px corners, subtle paper layers and small crisp offset shadows. Typography feels like a nostalgic shop sign with contemporary legibility, small mono labels and calm editorial spacing. A small forest-green and cream striped awning motif can appear over the proprietor area, not over the entire page. Overall a thoughtful tidy desktop dashboard with tactile paper warmth, old-shop charm, mature wit and a strong clear grid. Illustration-led, not photorealistic and not plastic toy 3D. Premium craft, not messy vintage grunge.

Visual direction for CANDIDATE 05: FULLY THREE-DIMENSIONAL cozy miniature corner-shop UI, deliberately redesigned to match the matte VINYL TOY mole in image 1. The character must stay chunky and short with the exact rounded 3D snout, glasses, hat and green apron from the reference; never use the tall character. Position him standing on a modest warm-wood miniature counter/podium as a substantial physical figure, large enough to be a visual anchor, with soft contact shadows.
This must not be a flat dashboard with a 3D mascot pasted onto it. Carry actual material thickness and depth into the complete interface: sculpted ivory ceramic/plastic card trays with rounded thick edges and visible sidewalls, an extruded deep-forest-green debt display with inset cream numerals, an elevated brick-red pill-shaped physical CTA with rounded bevels, a genuinely recessed input field, chunky tactile checkboxes pressed into the task tray, embossed small navigation tabs, a physical toggle switch, a gently curling cream paper receipt hanging over the edge of its holder, a raised red wax/rubber recommendation stamp, tiny brass-like fixtures. Use believable bevel highlights, consistent top-left warm studio light, soft ambient occlusion and layered contact shadows to establish several depths. Buttons and panels have real mass, clean subtle material highlights; never a blurry neumorphism effect. Put readable crisp Korean UI typography on the front-facing surfaces, keep the app screen itself orthographic and easily scannable.
Background suggests a soft cream 3D shop alcove with a restrained forest-green/cream miniature awning or curved shelf behind the mascot only. The content remains a practical accessible task dashboard with almost all of the viewport functional UI. Premium art-directed soft 3D, satin matte vinyl and paper/wood craft, warm little collectible-toy world, delightful and carefully restrained. No glossy glassmorphism, no flat hard-outlined cartoon cards, no photorealistic clutter, no huge game-world scene replacing the app.
